title: Rapid unscheduled disassembly
caption:
Rocket engineers never say 'it exploded'. They say something much more polite. 🚀
A rocket is a controlled explosion pointed one way; one failed valve, pump or weld and it stops being controlled.
Would you sit in the front row?
sources: SpaceX, Starship Flight Test, 20 April 2023 (vehicle lost over the Gulf of Mexico; SpaceX described the test as a success for the data gathered)
FAA / news reports on concrete debris from the Starbase launch pad, April 2023
